diagnostics.name: Backend verifier

items.text: Surangel Whipps Jr., President of Palau, stated at the UN General Assembly that disruption in a key waterway threatens international stability, energy security, and global trade. He expressed support for the sovereignty of Gulf countries and condemned the Islamic Republic's actions in the Strait of Hormuz.

The father of Mohammad Matin Hosseini mourns the absence of his son at the start of the school year. Mohammad Matin Hosseini, a 17-year-old student, was killed on January 9, 2026, in Andisheh city, Tehran province. This video was recently released.

The German foreign minister stated that the Islamic Republic should engage in constructive talks to end the regional conflict. He also called for the Strait of Hormuz to be opened without any preconditions. These remarks were made during a meeting with Abbas Araghchi on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly.

On Wednesday, the first of Mehr, a birthday ceremony for Abolfazl Saedi was held at his grave. Attendees chanted the slogan "This fallen flower is a gift to the homeland." Abolfazl Saedi was a protester from December 2025 in Shahroud who was executed on June 16, 2026.

Sepehr Soltani, a 15-year-old boy with a lung disease, died on January 10, 2026, after a shooting and tear gas attack in Malekshahr, Isfahan. His sister lit a candle for him by joining the campaign "One Candle, One Name, One Memory."
While Masoud Pezeshkian is in New York, a senior Iranian official told Reuters that Tehran is reviewing the US response to Iran's proposal to end the conflicts.

Hussein Zarifi, commander of the Sajjad Saravan operational base, was killed in a clash with armed individuals. At least 13 military personnel were seriously injured. Several armed individuals were arrested and five were killed.

Hamid Rahmani Meneshadi, a lawyer and law professor at Yazd University, was arrested about two weeks ago after being summoned and attending court by security forces in Yazd. He remains in detention, and his place of custody is unknown. This news was reported by Harana News Agency.

Amir Ghalenoei stated before the friendly match with Uzbekistan that age is just a number and player readiness is important. He emphasized that the national team is for generational change, not youth promotion, which should happen in club and youth teams. The friendly match between Iran and Uzbekistan will be held on Thursday, 24 September 2026.
Tehran is reviewing its response to Washington. Mohsen Rezaei has defended Araghchi. This topic was discussed in the audio version of Titrawal with Niousha Saremi.

Ahmad Al-Shar'a, the leader of Syria, was the first speaker at the United Nations meeting and spoke about peace and negotiations with Israel. After the speech, a group of Syrians placed the Syrian flag around his neck. Additionally, the Islamic Republic team requested increased security from the United States.

In Shahrivar 1405, 82 human rights violations related to executions were recorded. These include 75 executions, 29 convictions, and 8 confirmations of death sentences by the Supreme Court. Several women were among those executed and convicted.

Three unidentified men were seen early Wednesday near a hotel in New York where Benjamin Netanyahu is expected to stay. The men fled the scene in two vehicles. New York police are investigating the incident.

The US Central Command announced that it has redirected 115 commercial ships to prevent their entry to or exit from Iranian ports and coastal areas. This action was taken until Wednesday, 23 September. CENTCOM stated that the purpose was to strictly enforce the "Steel Wall blockade."

Young job seekers from the villages of Moran and Amisheh Bozorg protested in front of the Dabbol Khazaei Sugarcane Company due to uncertainty about their employment status. The protesters stated that about 200 people have submitted their documents but have not received a clear response. A meeting with the company management has also been promised.

Iliana Yotova, the President of Bulgaria, stated at the UN General Assembly that the war in Iran and the drying of the Danube River have contributed to the global food crisis. She emphasized the importance of maritime security and Iran's adherence to international commitments. Bulgaria supports the freedom of international maritime transport.

A video received by Iran International shows a long line of heavy vehicles waiting to receive diesel in Fasa. The video was recorded on Wednesday, the first of Mehr. This event took place in Fars province.
Due to lack of workplace safety, eight workers in Saqez, Tuyserkan, Asadabad, Rahimabad, and Aliabad Katoul were involved in accidents. Three workers died and five others were injured.

Cristiano Ronaldo stated that he has no specific time for retirement and lives in the moment. After Portugal's elimination from the World Cup, he considered his future in the national team but was convinced to continue after talks with the federation and coach. Ronaldo also mentioned the possibility of reaching 1,000 goals for the national team.

Volodymyr Zelensky, President of Ukraine, stated at the UN General Assembly that new Shahed drones equipped with jet engines using Iranian technology, alongside Russian ballistic missiles, are among the most difficult threats to Ukraine. He announced that Russia has deployed 63,000 attack drones against Ukraine in the first eight months of this year. Over 7,700 of these drones were Shahed drones equipped with jet engines.

A video shows that on Wednesday, the first of Mehr, a special unit vehicle was stationed inside a school in Tabriz. This video was sent to Iran International. The exact time and place of the event are specified.

Marco Rubio, the US Secretary of State, reacted to Masoud Pezeshkian's remarks about Donald Trump, saying that the Islamic Republic has no standing to comment on international rules and preach to others. At a press conference on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, he accused the Iranian government of massacring its own people, attacking the national sovereignty and energy infrastructure of its neighbors, and violating the UN Charter. Pezeshkian had called Trump's speech a sign of 'bullying and the logic of force' and contrary to the UN Charter.

Workers of Shush municipality reported non-payment of their April salaries, May insurance fees, and some benefits. Social Security retirees also complained about delays in receiving their September pensions and supplementary insurance fees. These financial issues have caused dissatisfaction.

One day after the Araghchi-Witkoff meeting, reports indicate the absolute failure of negotiations between the Islamic Republic and the United States. Meanwhile in Tehran, three main IRGC media outlets strongly criticized Araghchi for negotiating "without permission" with the American representative and said the talks ended in Donald Trump's favor.

Sahand Naseri, a 15-year-old teenager, was killed by gunfire from government agents on the evening of January 8, 2026, in Eshtehard, Alborz province. A video showing his school books and belongings has been released. This incident was reported by Iran International.

Issue 185 of the Peace Line magazine was published, marking the 20th anniversary of the One Million Signatures campaign to change discriminatory laws against women. This issue includes interviews with founding members and women's rights activists reviewing the campaign's experience and impact. It also features content on the evolution of the women's movement in Iran and its connection to recent movements.

Neriya Laiter, the son of Israel's ambassador in Washington, was seriously injured in a car attack at the Makabim checkpoint in the West Bank. The attacker was killed by Israeli forces, and Neriya is in critical condition in a Jerusalem hospital. Netanyahu has met with his family.

Danny Danon, Israel's ambassador to the UN, stated that Iran's nuclear and missile capabilities have largely diminished. He said Israel's mission regarding Iran is not yet complete and that Israel will continue fighting Hezbollah, Hamas, and the Houthis. Danon also mentioned Israel's belief in peaceful negotiations with Damascus but expressed concerns about certain activities.

Jose Raul Molino, the President of Panama, spoke about the situation in the Strait of Hormuz at the UN General Assembly. He described the situation as a sign of inability to enforce international laws and resolve crises early. He also emphasized that this situation has caused issues such as attacks on innocent people and increased costs of food supplies.

Adidas unveiled the latest jersey designed for the German national football team. This jersey marks the end of 70 years of collaboration between the company and the German national team. Adidas's partnership with the Mannschaft ends after this jersey.

Behnam Taleblu, senior director of the Iran program at the Foundation for Defense of Democracies, said possible meetings and message exchanges between Islamic Republic and American officials on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly may continue, but they are unlikely to lead to a tangible outcome. He added that Tehran is trying to buy time to delay the pressure of sanctions and the possibility of heightened tensions.

Ali Sadrezadeh said that the closure of the Strait of Hormuz has become a global crisis, with rising energy prices and European diplomatic efforts highlighting its importance. He added that there is no clear solution for reopening the strait. Additionally, European and Arab countries are reluctant to enter the war directly, and the idea of creating a regional security mechanism has been raised.
A strong explosion occurred in Bandar Abbas at 00:13, and its shockwave was felt. The sound of the explosion was also heard from afar at 00:24. Windows in Bandar Abbas shook strongly around midnight.

Reza Pahlavi called for a change in the Western approach, urging support for the Iranian people instead of negotiations with the regime. He outlined the negative consequences of the Islamic Republic and proposed using Iran's frozen assets to support the people. He also stated that the removal of the Islamic Republic could change Iran's regional relations.

Jonas Gahr Støre, the Prime Minister of Norway, expressed deep concern about human rights violations in Iran during a meeting with Masoud Pezeshkian. The meeting took place on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York. Støre emphasized the importance of direct dialogue with Tehran and resolving disputes through diplomacy.

Britain has tightened restrictions on five Iranian banks including Bank Sepah and Bank Melli. License requests for these banks' activities will be rejected except in exceptional cases. This move is part of Britain's economic pressure on the Islamic Republic.

Persepolis club has made three new requests for the appeal session after their complaint about Yaser Asani's participation in Derby 107 was rejected. These requests include holding a hearing with lawyers present, full video recording of the session, and live streaming of the session. The Disciplinary Committee of the Football Federation declared Asani's participation as authorized.

Morad Vaisi, senior analyst at Iran International, stated that there is a likelihood of a major war and attack on the Islamic Republic within about 40 days. He said that only if the Islamic Republic retreats might the situation change. Diplomacy has a 40-day window to avoid a major war.

Morad Vaisi, senior analyst at Iran International, said that Trump's meeting on Tuesday with the leaders of 12 Arab countries indicates he is moving towards coordination with Arab countries for the upcoming war with the Islamic Republic.

In response to Masoud Pezeshkian's remarks at the United Nations, the US State Department's Persian-language spokesperson Roland McKay told Iran International reporter Maryam Rahmati that Washington's main goal is to prevent the Islamic Republic from acquiring nuclear weapons. He noted that Donald Trump also stressed this goal in his own speech.

Morad Vaisi, a senior analyst at Iran International, stated that in the remaining 40 days until the US elections, Arab countries, the US, and Israel will move towards coordination for an attack on the Islamic Republic. He pointed to a recent joint meeting of General Brad Cooper with commanders of the Israeli and Arab armies. This meeting is a sign of planning for this attack.

Tankers Tracker announced that nearly six million barrels of seized Iranian crude oil are being transferred from the Atlantic Ocean to the United States. The value of this shipment is estimated at around 600 million dollars. No further details about the tankers, seizure location, or arrival time have been provided.

Scott Bessent, US Treasury Secretary, said Washington has imposed unprecedented pressure on the Islamic Republic through economic siege and exclusion campaign, aiming to cut off Iran's financial flow. He predicted the Islamic Republic will eventually surrender and outlined three scenarios: internal conflict among regime members, a popular uprising, or forcing Iran to adhere to an agreement if they want one. Bessent also announced increased pressure on Iran's banking and transport networks and cooperation with the UAE and Turkey to target financial institutions involved in transferring billions of dollars.

The Islamic Republic delegation has traveled to New York for the UN General Assembly. The US government has imposed restrictions and requires permits for their purchases from wholesale stores and luxury goods. The US State Department had previously stated that officials of the Islamic Republic are not allowed to shop in New York.

Murad Vaisi announced in the audio version of Siyasat that there is a 40-day opportunity to avoid a major war. This topic was discussed in the Siyasat program. More details are provided in the audio version.

Masoud Pezeshkian emphasized the continuation of Iran's nuclear program at the UN General Assembly and stated that Tehran is ready for negotiations. Marco Rubio reacted to Pezeshkian's remarks and accused the Iranian government of violating international laws. This report was prepared by Samira Gharaei and Amir Giti.

Kambiz Tavana stated that the diplomatic path between the Islamic Republic and the US remains open, but both sides use different strategies. The US emphasizes increasing pressure while Iran tries to shift the cost to the region. The US position on preventing Iran from acquiring nuclear weapons is a bipartisan issue.

Reports indicate that embassies and consulates of the Islamic Republic abroad increasingly use administrative services to pressure Iranian opponents of the government. Dozens of activists have stated that their political orientations are checked when applying for services like passport renewal. Opponents of the Islamic Republic and supporters of the monarchy have had their requests denied.

Amir Giti said in a program that Pezeshkian's speech at the United Nations was more like a spokesperson for a group than the president of Iran. He stated that Pezeshkian did not speak on behalf of the Iranian people. These remarks were made in a program with Kambiz Hosseini.

Heavy clashes involving heavy weapons were reported early Thursday in the Dab area of Saravan. Hundreds of military forces have besieged Razi Hospital, allowing only ambulances to pass. Additionally, patients in the maternity ward were discharged without consent.

The Financial Action Task Force reported that 139 companies in Turkey are suspected of potentially circumventing sanctions on Iran. The organization also announced the halt of electronic shipments and turbojet engines to Iran. They called for stronger enforcement of financial sanctions against Iran in Turkey.

HSBC bank moved its board meeting from Dubai to London due to security concerns. The ongoing war with the Islamic Republic has disrupted travel for senior executives to the region. This decision was made because the conflicts affect air travel and economic activities in the Middle East.

Delsy Rodriguez, the interim president of Venezuela, stated that the energy agreement with the United States will help balance the global energy market. She also said that elections will be held in Venezuela and talks with the opposition have begun.

Jane Shaheen, a senior Democrat on the US Senate Foreign Relations Committee, called for using the new Russia and Iran sanctions law to counter China's support for the Islamic Republic. She stated that Chinese entities have supported the Islamic Republic during the war, contributing to attacks on US forces and facilities. Shaheen urged the Trump administration to increase pressure on Beijing to stop these supports.

Antonio Costa, President of the European Council, called for an end to the Islamic Republic's attacks on neighboring countries. He also emphasized the full restoration of freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz. Costa had previously condemned these attacks and considered the restoration of navigation freedom a priority for the European Union.

Fatemeh Mojallal won the gold medal in the women's lightweight single sculls rowing final at the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games with a time of 7:24:57. She finished ahead of competitors from Kazakhstan, Hong Kong, Thailand, South Korea, and Vietnam. This medal is the first gold in the history of Iranian women's rowing at the Asian Games.

Donald Trump stated that Iran will be one of the topics in his talks with Xi Jinping. Xi Jinping expressed hope that his visit to the US will be fruitful. The meeting takes place amid increased focus on the Islamic Republic in bilateral negotiations.
Shoja Panahi lost to Wang Chengjin from China in the final match of the 65-kg wushu sanda category and won the silver medal. He had previously defeated Gavin Hakkin from Vietnam 2-0 in the semifinal.

Sogand Sinkai lost to Wei Yu Di from China in the final of the 52-kg Wushu Sanda category and won the silver medal. She had defeated Chan Qing from Hong Kong in the semifinals. This is the fourth silver medal for the Iranian team at the Nagoya Asian Games.

Erfan Mohrami lost in the final of the 70-kg Wushu Sanda category against Mashov from China and won the silver medal. He earned Iran's third silver medal in Wushu and the sixth silver for the Iranian delegation. Mohrami defeated Alijan from Kazakhstan by a large margin in the semifinals.

Soheil Mousavi won the gold medal in the 75-kg sanda category by defeating Abdullayev from Kazakhstan in the final. He had previously defeated Turkanbayev from Uzbekistan in the semifinals. The Iranian sanda national team won one gold and three silver medals in this competition.

Four UN special rapporteurs condemned the use of deadly force against Kurdish porters and Baloch fuel carriers and called for an end to these killings. They emphasized that these groups are among the most economically deprived in Iran and should not pay with their lives due to poverty. The rapporteurs also demanded independent investigations into the deaths.

More than 130 UN human rights experts called for coordinated government action to counter transnational repression of opponents, journalists, and human rights defenders. They emphasized that governments are obligated to protect individuals from threats and cross-border violence. Experts warned that such repression leads to fear, self-censorship, and weakening of independent journalism.

Andriy Sybiha, Ukraine's foreign minister, met with Abbas Araghchi to discuss reciprocal measures to prevent escalation of tensions between the two countries. The meeting took place on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York. Both sides agreed to keep communication channels open.

Scott Bessent, US Treasury Secretary, said on Wednesday in an interview with Fox News that more than 80 to 90 percent of Iran's foreign flights have been halted and expressed doubt about how Iran's representatives at the UN would return home. He considered this situation part of the US economic ostracism campaign against the Islamic Republic and said that the Iranian government is under unprecedented pressure.

The Iranian women's four-person rowing team won the silver medal at the Nagoya Asian Games. The team, consisting of Mahsa Javor, Soha Fakhri, Saqi Maleki, and Hengameh Kamyab, finished second with a time of 6:27:24. China took first place and Japan finished third.

Kayhan newspaper supported Masoud Pezeshkian's speech at the UN General Assembly. The newspaper described his speech as a strong response to the US president. It also noted Pezeshkian's choice of black clothing as a sign of mourning for the martyrdom of the leader and military commanders.

Esmaeil Baghaei criticized Mark Carney's stance on the threat against Iran. Baghaei said Carney described the threat to destroy Iran as merely speaking the language of war, and instead of condemning US actions, he has accompanied Washington's positions. The foreign ministry spokesman also said that aligning with great powers cannot guarantee security and that submitting to US pressure makes countries vulnerable.

Fatemeh Majllal won the bronze medal in women's heavyweight rowing at the Nagoya Asian Games after winning gold in the lightweight category. She finished third in the final with a time of 7:35:99. Athletes from China and Uzbekistan took first and second places respectively.

Zeinab Norouzi and Kimia Zarei won the silver medal in the women's heavyweight double sculls final at the Nagoya Asian Games. They also won the gold medal in the women's lightweight double sculls event. These competitions took place at the Nagoya Asian Games.

A shopkeeper told Iran International in a video that in a laptop transaction, the customer paid five dollars and expected two dollars back. He returned 500,000 tomans for the two dollars. This issue reflects his concern about the value of money.

Amirhossein Mahmoudpour finished second in the men's lightweight single sculls final with a time of 6:52:59, earning the silver medal. The Chinese representative won first place with a time of 6:50:00. The South Korean rower finished third with a time of 6:53:00.

Farid Ramazani, a 31-year-old Tehran resident, was killed on the evening of January 8, 2026, during protests in Aryashahr, Tehran. Security forces shot him and also fired at his right hand finger, which had a tattoo of the imperial crown. Videos show his father crying at his grave on his birthday.

Sarina Naqsh, as the first female boxer from Iran in the Asian Games, won her 65 kg category match 3-2 against an Indonesian opponent and advanced to the round of 16. Boxing and women's boxing were banned in Iran after the 1979 revolution, but women's efforts have led to their return to international competitions. The path for Iranian female boxers has been paved starting from the 2025 Asian Youth Games in Bahrain.

Erfan Ghaneifard stated that Masoud Pezeshkian is not the representative of the Iranian nation at the UN General Assembly, and the main representative is Reza Pahlavi. He added that the Islamic Republic portrays itself as a victim of terrorism but supports armed groups in the region. He also said the Islamic Republic's policies have imposed costs on the Iranian people.

Nicolas Gilani stated that the US exerts the most financial pressure on the UAE, Oman, and Turkey but does not have such leverage over Russia. He said the only way for the Islamic Republic to escape these pressures is to use resources in Chinese banks. Iran can use these resources to meet its payment needs.

The head of the judiciary in Semnan province announced the arrest of a citizen in Shahroud related to the December 2025 protests. This individual was transferred to prison after being detained and issued a temporary detention order.

Videos received by Iran International show a large presence of security forces in Shiraz on Thursday, October 3rd. Concurrently with the worsening economic crisis and rising discontent, the Revolutionary Guards and Basij held a military and security program in the city.

Yahya Rahim Safavi said that due to lack of strategic information, it is unclear what is in the minds of Trump and Netanyahu. He added that Iran's armed forces have prepared plans for the worst scenarios. In case of a possible war, the front could extend to the Indian Ocean.

Benaam Imani's daughters visited their father's grave on the first day of school with their bags and books. Behnam Imani, a 37-year-old cabinetmaker and father of two young daughters, was killed by government agents in Rasht on January 8, 2026.

A citizen from Lorestan criticized the water and electricity outages in a video sent to Iran International. He said that while other countries advance scientifically and send probes to the deep sea, Iran still struggles with water and electricity cuts.

Mohammad Mohebi missed Iran's friendly matches against Uzbekistan and Russia due to residency issues and lack of an exit permit from Croatia. He joined Croatian team Rijeka after leaving Rostov in Russia. The friendly match between Iran and Uzbekistan will be held on September 23, and the match against Russia on September 28.

Roland McKean, the Farsi-speaking spokesperson for the US State Department, stated in an exclusive interview with Iran International on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly's annual meeting: "We want to cut off all the currents that keep the regime afloat." He added that the Islamic Republic must cease supporting proxy groups and abandon its nuclear activities. McKean also commented on the economic problems of Iranians, saying that the people of Iran deserve a prosperous and peaceful life.

The judiciary media announced the indictment of six officers in the case of sexual assault and battery of a teenager in Tabriz. These officers face charges of violating citizens' rights, creating distrust towards the armed forces, and intentional assault. The judiciary media did not include sexual assault among the charges.
Yousef Rahimi and Azad Rahmati, citizens of Baneh, were arrested by security forces. They were transferred to an unknown location. This incident occurred yesterday.

Sarkan Ern, founder of the aid organization Stelp in Germany, was sentenced to 10 years in prison by a court in Iran. He traveled to Iran in 2025 for a humanitarian mission and was arrested upon arrival. The Stelp organization is in contact with Turkish authorities for his release.
A citizen reported that pharmacies do not provide the full prescribed amount of Ruflo inhalation capsules. This medication is used for lung diseases. The issue was reported to Iran International.

Iranian women rowers won two gold medals and one silver medal at the 2026 Asian Games in Nagoya. Fatemeh Mojallal won the first gold medal for Iranian women rowing in the history of the Asian Games. This report was provided by Somayeh Mehri.

Some citizens have criticized Masoud Pezeshkian for denying the suppression and killing of protesters in Iran from the United Nations platform. This report was published by Seba Heydarkhani from Iran International.

Morteza Kazemian said Masoud Pezeshkian represented an oppressive and plundering minority in Iran, not the Iranian people. He added that Pezeshkian repeated the Islamic Republic's narrative about protests, the nuclear program, and regional security. These remarks were made regarding Pezeshkian's speech at the UN General Assembly.

Nine eye injury victims of the Mahsa uprising released a video message demanding the cancellation of Ali Zarei's death sentence. They called on people and human rights organizations not to remain silent against the crimes of the Islamic Republic and to work to prevent the execution.

The disciplinary committee of the University of Art has sentenced at least 35 students to temporary suspension from studies. The duration of this suspension ranges from two to four semesters. These rulings were issued for the mentioned students.

The disciplinary committee of Esteghlal club issued a suspended penalty for Saleh Hardani. Hardani was banned from training after the controversies of the 107th derby but returned after apologizing. The penalty will be enforced if similar behavior is repeated.

All flights of Iranian airlines to the UAE have been canceled. The Tehran to Dushanbe flight was forced to return due to Turkmenistan not granting airspace permission. This information was announced by the spokesperson of the Civil Aviation Organization.

The flight from Iran to Tajikistan on the morning of Thursday, October 3rd, was unable to continue after takeoff due to not receiving overflight permissions from Turkmenistan and Azerbaijan. The pilot stated that the plane had to return to Iran because the overflight permits were not issued.

A woman named Fatemeh Sadat Tabatabaei was killed by her husband in Bam. The prosecutor announced the arrest of the husband as the main suspect. The suspect's father is also under judicial investigation.

A number of applicants for family reunification visas gathered in front of the German embassy in Tehran. The protesters demanded faster visa issuance and an end to uncertainty. They complained about the prolonged processing time of their applications.
Arman Khodai won the silver medal in the pommel horse final with a score of 14.566. Representatives from Uzbekistan and Japan placed first and third respectively.

Amnesty International reported that 377 people were killed during the crackdown on the Mahsa Amini protests. The organization has over 150 additional names that will be announced after verification. Amnesty International emphasized that the actual number of deaths is much higher than this figure.

The Traffic Police Social and Cultural Deputy announced that out of 19,540 traffic accident fatalities last year, 24% were children and adolescents. 6% of the total fatalities were children aged 1 to 10 years, and 18% were in the 10 to 20 years age group. This statistic was reported by Colonel Ali Asghar Zare.

Nine lawyers in Gilan province were sentenced to a total of 14 years, seven months, and 15 days in prison for charges of propaganda against the regime and insulting the leadership. The sentence was issued by the Second Branch of the Revolutionary Court of Rasht. Another case regarding insulting sacred matters is under review in the Rasht Criminal Court Two.

The Iranian national rowing team won six medals, including two golds, three silvers, and one bronze, finishing second after China at the Nagoya Asian Games. Iranian athletes won medals in various women's and men's events. China became the champion with nine gold medals, and Uzbekistan took third place.

Low-income families in Qaleh Ganj report inability to afford clothing, bags, and shoes for students. The cost of clothing and shoes for one student can reach about ten million tomans. Economic poverty, long distances between villages, lack of local staff, and early marriage of girls are among the obstacles to education in the area.

Delsi Rodriguez, interim president of Venezuela, stated that the country has entered a new phase after political and natural crises. She thanked the US for its readiness to resume diplomatic relations with Venezuela. Venezuela seeks relations based on cooperation and mutual respect with the international community.

European officials including the President of the European Council, the German Foreign Minister, and the Norwegian Prime Minister met with Masoud Pezeshkian and Abbas Araghchi. They called for reducing regional tensions, cooperation with the International Atomic Energy Agency, and security of shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. They also emphasized resolving disputes through diplomacy.

Iranian and US officials have engaged in indirect talks. Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff, representatives of the Trump administration, and Abbas Araghchi, Iran's foreign minister, were in separate rooms. The Strait of Hormuz was a main topic of the negotiations.

UN experts have called on the Islamic Republic to stop using live ammunition against kolbars and fuel carriers. They demanded immediate, independent, and impartial investigations into deaths caused by security forces. Since December 2025, at least 25 kolbars and fuel carriers have died in related incidents.

Giorgia Meloni announced the allocation of 100 million euros to encourage investment in Italy's fashion industry. She attended the fashion week to show government support for the industry. This is the first time an Italian prime minister has attended the event since 2016.

The Supreme Court has overturned the death sentence of Arghavan Fallahi, a 24-year-old prisoner. She was previously sentenced to death on charges of rebellion in Tehran's Revolutionary Court. Her lawyer stated that no weapons were found on her.

Rouhollah Rahimpour referred to Scott Bessent's statements, saying the US aims to disrupt the Islamic Republic's ability to circulate money and trade through sanctions. The US expects these pressures to cause splits in the government or protests in society. The ultimate goal is to pressure the Islamic Republic toward an agreement with Washington.

In Maryanj, Hamadan, threatening graffiti against girls without mandatory hijab has been observed. This writing is located near a bus stop close to a girls' school. The government's pressure and restrictions to enforce hijab in Iran continue.

The third day of the UN General Assembly meeting continues in New York. Antonio Costa will speak today, followed by Benjamin Netanyahu. Netanyahu's speech is expected to focus on Iran, the Gaza war, and Israel's security.

Reports indicate a security atmosphere in the city of Fasa on the second of Mehr. Videos confirm the movement of masked armed forces and a vehicle carrying heavy weapons around the Khomeini Mosque. This information was published by Iran International.

Mark Rutte stated at the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks that threats remain real and some countries seek to create instability. He identified Iran, China, and North Korea as challenges facing NATO. He also emphasized strengthening NATO's defense capabilities.

Abdolnaser Hemmati, the governor of the Central Bank, in response to Britain's tightening of restrictions on five Iranian banks, said that they themselves had intended to impose restrictions on inactive banks abroad to reduce costs. He added that these banks have had no Iran-related banking operations for years due to US sanctions, and called Britain's action an instance of 'pouring oil as an offering to the shrine.'

Abulfazl Abutorabi reacted to the issue of Masoud Pezeshkian's return due to air sanctions, saying the US can keep Pezeshkian and put him in Trump's place. He added that Pezeshkian is a good president and can teach the Quran and Nahj al-Balagha to the American people. Abutorabi presented this statement humorously.

The French Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated that it wants the people of Iran to decide about themselves and their future. The deputy spokesperson called the protests of Dey 1404 a horrific and inhumane crackdown. These remarks were made in response to a question from Iran International.

Persian-speaking users reacted to the absence of Iranian representatives at the General Assembly, Daniel Ayvazi's speech at the Human Rights Council, and Kaya Kalas's meeting with Abbas Araghchi. Adela Borang from Iran International discussed these reactions.

Flight restrictions against Iranian airplanes have expanded in the region. After Iraq, Oman, and Azerbaijan, the UAE and Turkmenistan have also denied entry or passage to Iranian airplanes. All flights of Iranian airlines to the UAE have been canceled.

Iran and Middle East developments were main topics in leaders' speeches at the UN General Assembly. Key points included reopening the Strait of Hormuz, freedom of navigation, and Iran's nuclear program. More details were provided by Ali Rashid.

The Saudi Civil Defense Organization warned of a renewed attempt to attack Mecca. The warning was initially issued and then canceled. Additionally, six ballistic missiles fired by the Houthis were intercepted and destroyed.

Reports from Dastgerd prison in Isfahan indicate worsening health conditions and the spread of diseases such as meningitis. Several prisoners have been transferred to hospitals and visitations have been restricted. There is also widespread infestation of lice, fleas, and ticks, along with shortages of medicine and medical services.

According to information received by Iran International, all flights of Iranian airlines to the United Arab Emirates have been cancelled. These flights were operating from cities including Tehran, Kish, Mashhad and Shiraz. The cancellation follows the implementation of US restrictions on the foreign activities of Iranian airlines, and US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent had previously announced that these activities would be halted from the first of Mehr.

Iranian rowers won gold, silver, and bronze medals at the Nagoya 2026 Asian Games rowing competitions. Fatemeh Mojallal won two medals, gold and bronze, while Amirhossein Mahmoudpour won a silver medal. This report was provided by Alireza Modiri for Iran International.

The morning flight on Thursday, October 2, by Varash Airlines from Tehran to Dushanbe was forced to return to Khomeini Airport after not receiving overflight permission from Turkmenistan and Azerbaijan. This occurred due to new US sanctions and increased flight restrictions in the region. The flight was consequently canceled.

Yahya Rahim Safavi stated that the Yemeni Houthis have made significant progress in weapon production. He also mentioned that the connection of the Persian Gulf, Red Sea, and the Straits of Hormuz and Bab al-Mandab will change the battlefield. Ahmad Vahidi supported Masoud Pezeshkian's speech at the UN and said Iran is not afraid of war.

Sasan Zamani, 36 years old and resident of Kerman, was sentenced to five and a half years in prison. He was tried on charges including assembly and collusion to commit crimes against national security and propaganda activities against the regime. Zamani was arrested on January 10 in Kerman.

Donald Trump, the President of the United States, welcomed Xi Jinping, the President of China, and his wife at Andrews Air Force Base. The visit is scheduled for three days, and a red carpet was laid out for the ceremony. The reactions of Trump and Xi to the passage of a B-1 bomber during the US national anthem attracted attention.

Oksana Chusovitina, a 51-year-old Uzbek gymnast, reached the vault final in her seventh Asian Games appearance and finished seventh. She has participated in eight Olympic Games and aims to compete in the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics. Chusovitina has had one of the most unique careers in gymnastics.

The Iranian women's lightweight double sculls team won the first team gold medal for Iranian women's rowing at the Nagoya Asian Games. Solmaz Abbasi explained the importance of these medals and the difficult training conditions for female rowers.

Delsy Rodriguez stated that Venezuela has entered a new phase after political and natural crises. She thanked the US for its readiness to resume diplomatic relations with Venezuela. Rodriguez expressed the desire to maintain cooperative and respectful relations with the international community.

Hassan Taftian advanced to the semi-finals of the 100-meter dash at the Nagoya Asian Games with a time of 10.46 seconds. Fatemeh Mohitizadeh also topped the standings on the first day of the heptathlon.

Reza Shafakhah, the lawyer of Amirhossein Mousavi, announced that his client was tried in Branch 15 of the Tehran Revolutionary Court on charges of moharebeh and corruption on earth. These charges can lead to severe sentences, including the death penalty. The third session of Mousavi's trial was held on Monday, 30 Shahrivar.
A number of Iranians living in Germany gathered in Hamburg at the start of the new school year. They commemorated the students killed in Iran. They read out the names of these students.

Donald Trump stated during his meeting with the Chinese president that they have developed an excellent friendship and made significant progress in bilateral relations. He mentioned plans to discuss security, technology, and artificial intelligence with Xi Jinping. The two countries are also working towards more balanced trade relations, including new market access for American farmers and ranchers.

The interrogation session of Ali Kalateh Dolati, a detainee related to the December 2025 protests, was held on Sunday, September 29, at the seventh investigative branch of Sabzevar Public and Revolutionary Prosecutor's Office. He was charged with propaganda against the regime and defended himself. Ali Kalateh Dolati is imprisoned in Sabzevar prison.

Masoud Pezeshkian, the President of Iran, will be interviewed today at 6 PM Eastern Time by Bret Baier on Fox News. The interview will be at 1:30 AM Tehran time on Friday. The exact time and network for the interview have been announced.

Xi Jinping met with Donald Trump at the White House and said China and the US have a responsibility to cooperate for human progress. He emphasized honest dialogue and increasing mutual trust, noting broad areas for cooperation. Xi also called for healthy competition and avoiding conflict.

Najmeh Amini, a prisoner sentenced to death, is held in Vakilabad Prison in Mashhad. She has been sentenced to death and over 12 years in prison in two separate cases. The charges include blasphemy, acting against national security, and propaganda against the regime.

Ehsan Hajsafi reached 149 national team appearances in a friendly match against Uzbekistan, equaling Javad Nekounam's record. He also captained the team in this game. In the 10th minute, he made a mistaken pass that led to Uzbekistan's first goal.

Abbas Araghchi met with the foreign ministers of Pakistan, Ukraine, and Poland on the sidelines of the 81st UN General Assembly. The Pakistani Foreign Ministry stated that they discussed bilateral relations and regional developments. Araghchi and the Ukrainian foreign minister emphasized the importance of diplomacy in managing tensions.

The fifth Iran Conference, hosted by the Nofdi Institute, is underway in Washington. The topics of this two-day meeting include US policy towards the Islamic Republic, the future of negotiations, Iran's nuclear program and military capability, and sanctions.

A citizen sent a video to Iran International complaining about paying 400,000 tomans for a package of biscuits and two packages of chips and puffed snacks, most of which were filled with air. This issue was raised as a complaint about the price and quality of the packages. The video was sent to Iran International.

Ali Hossein Ghazizadeh said reactions to the meeting of Western officials with Islamic Republic authorities should be broader and hold Western politicians accountable for what he called double standards on human rights. He emphasized that in the context of reports of crimes against humanity in Iran, dialogue with Islamic Republic officials without considering these issues is questionable.

Miad Maleki, former head of the sanctions targeting office at the US Treasury, said that restricting flights of Iranian airlines by regional countries is to protect airports and private companies. This measure is taken to shield them from the consequences of sanctions.

Abdulrahman Abdollahi-Pour, a member of the Hana Human Rights Organization, was detained in Turkey and transferred to a foreign nationals' detention center. The organization warned that returning him to Iran could lead to arrest, torture, and even the death penalty. Hana has called on Turkey to halt his deportation and ensure his access to a lawyer.

The Iranian national football team lost 3-1 to Uzbekistan in their first match after the 2026 World Cup. This was Iran's first preparatory match before the 2027 Asian Championship. Sardar Azmoun played for one half after months of absence, and Denis Derghahi was also in the lineup.

The director of disability prevention and social integration at the Welfare Organization reported ongoing problems for children with disabilities in rural areas accessing education. Causes of school dropout include poverty, lack of trained teachers, and transportation issues. These barriers remain especially in less privileged areas.

More than 300,000 dahlia flower heads were used to create a 29-meter artwork in Bradford's Centenary Square. The piece was designed by Shiraz Ali, a local artist. This is the first British version of the "Flower Carpet," an event regularly held in Belgium since the 1970s.

Benjamin Netanyahu and his wife arrived in the US to speak at the UN General Assembly. He will stay in New York for less than eight hours before returning to Israel. Netanyahu will meet with nine world leaders, five of whom are from Latin American countries.

A father married off his eight-year-old daughter due to financial problems. This event is an example of child marriage and a violation of children's rights. No further information about the man's age or the location has been released.

Iran ranked sixth in the medal table at the end of the fifth day of the 2026 Asian Games in Nagoya with 12 medals, including 3 gold, 6 silver, and 1 bronze. Gold medals were won in rowing and wushu. China, Japan, South Korea, Kazakhstan, and Uzbekistan are the top five teams in the table.

Mohammad Shehbaz Sharif, Prime Minister of Pakistan, met with Masoud Pezeshkian on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly. Abbas Araghchi, Mohammad Ishaq Dar, Khawaja Muhammad Asif, and Tariq Fatemi also attended the meeting. The discussions focused on bilateral relations and regional developments.

A citizen sent a video showing pollution from the Dorud cement factory. The Lorestan Environmental Protection Organization confirmed the factory is outdated and its pollution has increased. The factory produces about 900,000 tons annually.

Abbas Araghchi had brief and informal meetings with foreign ministers of several countries on the sidelines of the 81st UN General Assembly in New York. These meetings included ministers from Jordan, Tajikistan, Armenia, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, Poland, Ukraine, Lebanon, and the Prince of Brunei. The news was announced by Abbas Araghchi's Telegram channel.

Joachim Wadtfol, Germany's foreign minister, stated that any negotiation with Tehran must end the nuclear threat posed by the Islamic Republic and expressed doubt about Iran's willingness to abandon its nuclear program. He emphasized the importance of freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz and rejected Iran's collection of tolls there. Wadtfol also condemned the Houthis in Yemen and announced Germany's support for Saudi Arabia and the Yemeni government.

Mohammad Naderi, a prisoner in Tehran's Great Prison, was sentenced to death for espionage by Branch 23 of the Tehran Revolutionary Court. This sentence was reported by the HRANA news agency. Naderi was arrested during security developments related to the war.

The Israeli government launched an advertising campaign against Iran's nuclear program in New York ahead of the speeches by Israeli and Palestinian leaders at the UN General Assembly. Messages such as "Nuclear Iran is a threat to the entire world" were displayed on 500 digital billboards and 12 trucks in Times Square and Manhattan. The cost of this advertising was paid by the Israeli government.

Babak Khatami, a pediatrician, stated that sanctions are not the sole cause of drug shortages and cited factors like budget deficits and drug distribution structure. He warned of an impending silent crisis in Iran's health sector. He also emphasized the need for transparency and international oversight.

Xi Jinping, the President of China, supported the return of the US and Iran to the Islamabad agreement. He urged both countries to quickly return to resolving issues through negotiation. Earlier, Xi Jinping emphasized the responsibility of both countries for the progress of humanity in a meeting with Donald Trump.
